projects.name: Digital Calibration Frequency - Designed, developed and deployed a linear regression model for predicting the number of days
projects.description:
Digital Calibration Frequency - Designed, developed and deployed a linear regression model for predicting the number of days for the next calibration of devices, using Weibull Analysis and Azure Databricks. Automated CI/CD pipelines to handle changes 
Predicting Concentration Value - Predicted the concentration value for a spectrum dataset using PCA and SVM Regressor. Principal Component Analysis was used to reduce the dimensionality of the dataset and replicate the functionalities of an existing tool including the Hotelling T2 plots. The model achieved 100% accuracy in matching the predictions with the existing tool.
Product Classification - Developed a multi-class logistic regression model to predict the category of products based on input values. Deployed the model as a pickle file into Azure Blob, and created an API to predict the results each time a new file is uploaded. Also created CI/CD PIPELINES TO HANDLE CHANGES WITHOUT MANUAL INTERVENTION.
Data Linkage – Phrase Extraction - Led efforts in the extraction of Site Information, Location, and Address details from available text information using Fuzzy Matching and Levenshtein distance algorithms. Deployed the model into an in-house platform, 
RSC - Developed a proof-of-concept that used FastText and Jaccard Similarity to generate a maximum similarity score between two addresses above the threshold limit and assign the address to the predictive field. Applied standard text cleaning techniques 
Insights - Key Phrase Extraction & Summary - Developed and deployed a model for key phrase extraction and summarizing customer reviews and complaints. Used TF-IDF and Word & Sentence Tokenization to clean and analyze the text, and generated summaries based on a threshold limit. Deployed Model in an in-house platform and the output were very useful to the end user
Forecasting OEE - Developed a forecasting model for Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) of different machines using XGBoost. Used key fields that decide the OEE value of the machines and the data was stored in a database. The training and prediction codes were deployed into an Azure Virtual Machine and a cron-job was created to run the codes as per the requirements. The model was saved into Azure Blob Storage and also created CI/CD pipelines for deployment
Anomaly Detection of Sensors – Led anomaly detection of sensors by using static thresholding. Analyzed IOT data received from sensors and used it to forecast anomalies. Fixed a threshold limit of temperature and classified those points as anomalies.
